purpose: Define the requested large-scale target without treating blueprint tasks, adapter smoke checks, or unadmitted applications as experimental outcomes.
admission_rule: An application must be version-pinned, self-hosted, resettable, and license-audited.
Every bound workflow must have an independent clean, fault, and evolution oracle; agent self-reports are never ground truth.
Every bound workflow must pass a clean negative-control and fault-positive-control gate.
All three strategies must produce complete standard run-records in a matched pilot before any repetition is counted.
A behavior-preserving UI evolution must pass its invariant check before entering the evolution condition.
Provider, model, framework, task, condition, and repetition strata remain separate in the ledger.

current_inventory_source.interpretation: The validator recomputes current coverage from these files; the target is not evidence that the current inventory is admitted.

non_substitution_rules: Do not fill the 30-application target with repeated runs of BookStack.
Do not count a candidate workflow, provider connectivity check, framework adapter smoke, or oracle-only run as an admitted cell.
Do not pool pure visual and hybrid provider/model strata, or collapse infrastructure failures into task failures.
Do not start 14-repetition confirmatory collection before pilot variance and power inputs are frozen.
